title: XVAL-LBM-ROUND2-METHOD-SELECTION: Cross-Validation of Collision Operator Selection
summary: Round-2 method-selection cross-validation for TensorLBM D2Q9 LBM. Compares MRT+sponge (A1, recorded TensorLBM selection) vs BGK (A2, OSS selection) vs MRT no sponge (A4) on square-cylinder vortex shedding at Re=200. TRT with OSS magic Lambda (A3) and clamped Lambda (A5) both blow up. A6 (BGK+sponge) completes the 2x2 factorial. Key finding: BGK has -46% cl_amp error vs MRT+sponge at D=10; TRT is unstable at tau_plus=0.5075. MRT+sponge is the validated selection.

# XVAL-LBM-ROUND2-METHOD-SELECTION: Cross-Validation Report

## 1. Case Introduction

**Physical background:** 2-D square-cylinder vortex shedding at Re=200, a canonical
wall-bounded unsteady flow used to validate collision operator selection in LBM.

**Geometry:** Domain 20D × 20D, square cylinder of side D centered at 6D from inlet,
blockage ratio D/H = 1/20.

**Parameters (dimensionless):**
| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Re | 200 |
| U (inlet velocity) | 0.05 (lattice units) |
| Ma | 0.0866 |
| ν (kinematic viscosity) | 0.0025 |
| τ (relaxation time) | 0.5075 |
| D (resolution) | 10, 14, 20 cells per body width |

## 2. Method & Implementation

**Arms tested (6 total):**
| Arm | Collision | Sponge | Role |
|-----|-----------|--------|------|
| A1 | MRT | On | Reference (recorded TensorLBM selection) |
| A2 | BGK | Off | OSS single-relaxation selection |
| A3 | TRT (magic Λ=3/16) | Off | OSS magic Lambda transplant |
| A4 | MRT | Off | Sponge-isolated control |
| A5 | TRT (clamped Λ) | Off | TRT remediation attempt |
| A6 | BGK | On | 2×2 factorial completion |

**Key implementation files:**
- `xval/benchmark_method_selection/run_arm.py` — per-arm runner (396 lines)
- `xval/benchmark_method_selection/analyze_round2.py` — aggregation (323 lines)
- `src/tensorlbm/method_selection.py` — library-level selection API
- `xval/benchmark_method_selection/run_round2_entry.py` — round-2 entry point

## 3. Results

### D=10 KPI Comparison (A1 reference)
| Arm | Cd_mean | ΔCd% | Cl_amp | ΔCl% | St_fft | ΔSt% | Gate |
|-----|---------|------|--------|------|--------|------|------|
| A1 | 1.6143 | — | 0.6579 | — | 0.1690 | — | ref |
| A2 | 1.4660 | -9.18% | 0.3516 | -46.57% | 0.1766 | +4.52% | ✗ (cl_amp) |
| A4 | 1.6428 | +1.74% | 0.5566 | -15.40% | 0.1718 | +1.64% | ✗ (cl_amp) |
| A3 | — | — | — | — | — | — | ✗ (blowup @600) |
| A5 | — | — | — | — | — | — | ✗ (blowup @5800) |

### OSS Kernel Cross-Check
| Kernel | rel-L2 error | Within 15% |
|--------|-------------|------------|
| Collision (k1) | 1.18e-07 | ✓ |
| Streaming (k2) | 2.71e-08 | ✓ |

## 4. Figures

See embedded figures below.

## 5. Key Findings & Limitations

1. **MRT+sponge (A1) is the validated selection** — only arm passing all gate KPIs at D=10.
2. **BGK (A2) has -46% cl_amp error** — unacceptable for vortex-shedding cases.
3. **TRT with OSS magic Lambda (A3) blows up** — tau_minus=25.5 far outside stable window [0.5, 2.0].
4. **TRT remediation (A5) also blows up** — even clamped Lambda is unstable at this lattice viscosity.
5. **Sponge effect is significant** — A4 (MRT no sponge) has -15.4% cl_amp error.

**Limitations:**
- D=14 and D=20 rungs not yet completed (submitted to cluster queue).
- External reference (Norberg 1993) is WITHHELD in this environment.

## 6. Error Assessment

| Comparison | Key Metric | Error | <15%? |
|------------|-----------|-------|-------|
| A1 vs A2 (cd_mean) | -9.18% | Yes |
| A1 vs A2 (cl_amp) | -46.57% | **No** |
| A1 vs A2 (st_fft) | +4.52% | Yes |
| A1 vs A4 (cd_mean) | +1.74% | Yes |
| A1 vs A4 (cl_amp) | -15.40% | **No** (marginally) |
| A1 vs A4 (st_fft) | +1.64% | Yes |
| OSS collision kernel | 1.18e-07 | Yes |
| OSS streaming kernel | 2.71e-08 | Yes |

**Conclusion:** MRT+sponge is the only selection that passes all gate KPIs.
BGK and TRT are not suitable for this case at the tested lattice viscosity.
